description: This Dart source file defines the HomeScreen widget, a key component for the Flutter front-end of a micro-learning application. It builds the main landing page with personalized greetings, an animated header, progress overview, and a list of suggested lessons, including navigation to lesson details. It also contains internal widgets and animation logic for smooth appearance effects.
